method.order: split order then numeric frame ID; SHA256 original source files
method.rgb: all RGB frames; Pillow BOX thumbnail maximum 160x90; Rec709 luminance; green G>1.12R and G>1.04B, 25<luminance<225
method.watermark_exclusion: yellow-like pixels R>1.15B and G>1.15B and abs(R-G)<30 excluded from green screen; conservative chromatic proxy, not exact watermark removal; watermark text may remain
method.depth: full-frame uint16; only raw values>0; raw quantiles not calibrated surface distances
method.samples: daylight proxy closest median luminance to110; low light minimum median luminance; near smallest nonzero median depth with valid fraction>.2 and median luminance>=70; numeric ID tie-break
method.statistics: quantiles over repeated image frames/boxes, not independent trees/fruit/leaves

limitations: Green support is a pixel proxy, not leaf-instance masks; grass/background and yellow leaves can bias it.
No calibrated per-device intrinsics or confirmed depth alignment; no botanical sizes inferred.
Repeated observations do not establish independent sample counts or orchard population distributions.
Opaque bags hide fruit and rear paper; neck tie, seam thickness and backside remain inferred.
Close views cannot establish complete tree topology, branch age or full crown dimensions.

visible_features.status: visual observation; no crease amplitude or tie material measured

visible_features.feature: pointed elongated blades, curved/drooping/rolled poses, mixed bright and shaded green, blade overlap
visible_features.status: visual observation; precise leaf sequence and hidden attachment not resolved

visible_features.feature: thicker brown woody axes, finer lateral shoots, irregular junctions, gaps and clustered foliage

visible_features.feature: mature red/yellow fruit and young pale green fruit, multiple adjacent fruit and partial occlusion
visible_features.status: visual observation; no independent physical dimensions
